title: Winner of an Array Game
description: An array game repeatedly compares the first two remaining values: the larger stays at the front and the smaller moves to the end. The first value to win `k` consecutive rounds is the winner. Return its value. Input: distinct-value array `arr` and positive `k`. Output: the winner.
hints: Keep a running total or frequency count rather than recomputing over all prefixes.
Test repeated values, zeros, and minimum-size inputs.
